intro: Weigh time, cost and effects to recommend a solution under specific conditions.

piezas.titulo: Choosing a room for a workshop

frases.estudio: Rom A ligger nær stasjonen og koster 2 400 kroner. Det har plass til 24 personer, men teknisk utstyr må leies separat. Rom B koster 1 900 kroner og inkluderer prosjektor. Det ligger 15 minutters gange fra stasjonen og har plass til 18 personer. Gruppen forventer 16 deltakere.
frases.alumno: Room A is near the station and costs 2 400 kroner. It can hold 24 people, but the technical equipment is hired separately. Room B costs 1 900 kroner and includes a projector. It is a fifteen-minute walk from the station and can hold 18 people. The group expects 16 participants.

texto: A useful comparison applies the same criteria to each option. **Selv om løsning A er raskere, koster den mer** («Although solution A is faster, it costs more») acknowledges an advantage and a limitation. If data are missing, give a conditional recommendation: **Hvis leveringstiden bekreftes, velger vi A** («If the delivery time is confirmed, we choose A»).

pregunta.texto: What advantage does room B have?

opciones.texto: It includes a projector and costs less
opciones.explicacion: Room B costs less than A and includes a projector.

opciones.texto: It is closer and holds 24 people
opciones.explicacion: Room A is the one that is close and can hold 24.
Room B also has a rental cost.

pregunta.texto: Recommend a room with a concession and a condition related to the number of attendees.

textos: Selv om rom B ligger lenger fra stasjonen, er det rimeligere og har prosjektor. Hvis gruppen ikke blir større enn 18 personer, velger vi B.

piezas.explicacion: Model: use comparable data; the other option can be recommended with justification.
